meta.source: OpenGeoMetadata GitHub repositories (https://github.com/OpenGeoMetadata), Aardvark records in metadata-aardvark/
meta.method: Per repo: list up to about 120 JSON files in each resource-class folder, pick 36 spread across classes, keep 16 (records with a bounding box first, round-robin by class). A sample for demos, not a full harvest. Run scripts/harvest_ogm.py to rebuild.

fields.b: bbox minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat (west greater than east means it crosses the antimeridian)
